name: GitHub Copilot Max

reset.rule: Resets on the 1st of each calendar month at 00:00 UTC, whatever your billing date.
stipulations: Chat, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, Spaces, Spark, third-party agents and code review spend credits. Code completions and next edit suggestions don't.
Each model charges its own per-token API price. There are no multipliers and no free models.
Prices roughly double above the long-context threshold: 200K or 272K tokens, 100K for Claude Haiku 5.5.
Auto model selection in Chat or cloud agent is 10% off.
Base credits are spent first, then flex credits. GitHub says the flex amount can change from month to month.
Code review also uses GitHub Actions minutes.

overage: At the limit, Chat and agents stop until the 1st unless you set a budget for additional usage at github.com/settings/billing. Additional usage bills at the same per-token rates at month end, with alerts at 75%, 90% and 100% of the budget. GitHub doesn't say whether it's on by default for individuals; the old default budget was $0. There's no fallback to a cheaper model any more. Completions keep working. You can also upgrade mid-month and pay only the difference.

how: $200 of AI Credits a month (10,000 base plus 10,000 flex), spent at each model's per-token API price.
Credits reset on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. Completions and next edit suggestions are unlimited and free.
ext: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Kimi and Microsoft MAI models are all available, each at its own per-token price.
Works in VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, Xcode, Eclipse and Copilot CLI. Claude Code and Codex as third-party agents (public preview) spend the same credits.
quirks: Since 1 June 2026 there are no premium requests or multipliers. Docs that still mention 300 premium requests and $0.04 per request are out of date.
Annual Pro and Pro+ subscribers stay on the old premium-request billing until the plan expires, then drop to Free.
Getting a Business or Enterprise seat cancels a personal Pro, Pro+ or Max plan, with a prorated refund.
Older clients can show wrong usage. Use VS Code 1.120, JetBrains plugin 1.9.1, Copilot CLI 1.0.48 or newer.
GitHub may apply temporary rate limits beyond the monthly credits. It publishes no numbers.
Max gets every Copilot Fusion tier (Standard, High and Max) and Claude Fable 5.2.

modelTable.title: GitHub Copilot: model prices per 1M tokens
modelTable.note: 1 AI Credit is $0.01. 1M output tokens on Claude Opus 5.5 costs 2,000 credits; on GPT-6 Luna it costs 50.
modelTable.footer: Anthropic models also charge for cache writes. Free and Student plans get auto model selection only.

events.what: Copilot Fusion 30% discount ends on paid plans. The docs say 30 Nov; the plans page banner says 31 Dec.
Gemini 4 Carbon price doubles to $4 in, $20 out per 1M tokens. Gemini 4 Argon promo price ends.
MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash promo prices end. Both then double.
